name: Urolithin A
summary: Urolithin A is a gut-microbiome-derived metabolite produced from ellagitannin and ellagic-acid precursors. Randomized human trials report some favorable muscle-endurance, strength, and mitochondrial-biomarker signals, while several important primary functional outcomes have been null or inconclusive.
description: Canonical urolithin A research entity for evidence and safety integration. Publication remains held until trial-specific efficacy, formulation, sponsorship, longer-term safety, and outcome-boundary evidence has passed the site’s review gates.
primary_effects_or_targets: mitophagy-associated signaling; mitochondrial quality control; skeletal-muscle performance
